name: Risograph Press
desc: A two-ink risograph press caught mid-run: each drum prints its own artwork through its own rotated halftone screen, the registration drifting a hair out and back while roller banding crawls down the sheet and the paper shows through everywhere the ink is not.

ink.doc: ink laydown — dot coverage from ghosted to over-inked

energy.doc: press judder, roller variance, sheen amplitude

density.doc: how many shapes the separations carry

hue.doc: first drum's ink hue (340 = fluoro pink; the second drum sits opposite)

speed.doc: press rate — registration drift + band scroll

style.doc: duotone fluoro pink+blue / trio three-drum overprint / mono_key single ink, dot size carries every value / wet over-inked and puddling out of register / negative fluoro knocked out of a black sheet

act.doc: press: steady run · registration: the press wanders badly out of register · run: ink density fades and re-inks in long cycles

seed.doc: deterministic seed — same number, same piece
